title: Allotrope 2
summary: The second piece in the Allotrope series takes its rhythmic research into dub techno. Subdivisions of squares, octahedra and eight-pointed star forms provide the basis for six instrumental layers.

descriptions.content:
A segunda peça da série Allotrope leva a investigação rítmica para o dub techno. As subdivisões de quadrados, octaedros e formas estreladas de oito pontas servem de base a seis camadas instrumentais.

Fotografia de capa: José Hipólito (2022).

The second piece in the Allotrope series takes its rhythmic research into dub techno. Subdivisions of squares, octahedra and eight-pointed star forms provide the basis for six instrumental layers.
